title: Tecnópata · las habilidades de Bip
description: Tecnópata's skills, all Bip's (docs/animas/tecnopata/): Rayo de energía (magic, and what runs out by the clock on the foe lasts 5 s more), Rayo encogedor (shrinks a foe, Defensa much lower for 15 s), Confusión (30 s hitting its own), Rayo de sanación (a cure on the clock for 15 s), Rayo solar (a dual with Foc Binari: Bip charges sun yellow, and sweeps every foe with Quemado II as the next round starts) and Explosión (fire on all, Cegado for a round; Aitor sits the next round out and Bip forms again). One player leads both in the fight tester, against three sturdy dogs. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }));

steps.caption: Tecnópata's skills, Bip's: Rayo de energía, Rayo de sanación, Explosión, Confusión and Rayo encogedor
Rayo de energía: Bip fires a cyan ray at the burning dog; its fire lasts 5 s more (+5 s on its clock, a cyan ring round it)
Rayo encogedor: a white ray, and the dog shrinks; its Defensa much lower for 15 s
Encogido: the dog stands smaller, Defensa ▼ on its plate
Confusión: waves of the mind twist from Bip to the dog's head; cyan lights circle it
The foes' turn: the confused dog goes for one of its own

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.hp = Math.max(1, g.hp - 60); });

steps.caption: Rayo de sanación: a green ray to Gerard; Sanación for 15 s
Sanación: green lights rise up Gerard, +PV on the clock every 3 s
Rayo solar, its turn: Gerard's fire streams into Bip, which turns sun yellow
Bip charged, sun yellow, until the next round starts
The foes act; as the next round starts Bip sweeps every dog with a sun-yellow ray: Quemado II on each
Explosión: Bip dives into the dogs and blows up; fire on all, Cegado until the round ends
No Bip: Aitor loses his next turn
The next round: Aitor sits it out (the message says so)
The round after: Bip forms again on its own out of Aitor's nanites
